messages:
incident-bot: Paging on-call: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate (region: us-west-2). Error rate 5xx=6.2% > threshold 2% :rotating_light:
Sam M: i'm on it, ack
Lee SRE: looking at APM traces, seeing spikes of gateway timeouts between gateway -> runtime (504s)
Maya Infra: any recent deploys touching prefix-cache/kv config? i noticed PR #428 changed eviction heuristics
Sam M: checking deploy history...
Deploy-bot: rollout started: config-change-eviction-heuristic by Maya Infra at 2026-03-15T12:05Z
Sam M: that timestamp lines up with the start of error increase, very suspect
Lee SRE: querying kv metrics: eviction_rate per-shard spiked ~100x; miss_rate up 40%; kv read latency x3 on hot shards
Sam M: pasting a short snippet from logs:
```
[2026-03-15T12:07:12Z] shard=kv-prefix-12 evicted=12000 miss=4300 read_ms=12.3
[2026-03-15T12:07:30Z] gateway timeout upstream=runtime-01 code=504
[2026-03-15T12:07:45Z] shard=kv-prefix-12 evicted=8000 miss=5100 read_ms=18.9
```
Ops Jess: customer impact? which customers are affected?
Tom CS: CS notes: three paid customers reported 502/504s in the past 20m; trying to correlate requests -> prefixes. No data loss reported, calls are failing with gateway timeouts/502s
Sam M: mitigation options: 1) immediate rollback of eviction heuristic change, 2) increase reserved memory/capacity on hot kv nodes and bump TTLs, 3) routing policy to bypass problematic cache shards and hit backing store directly for specific prefixes
Maya Infra: i can bump node memory and TTLs but that requires restarting the targeted kv nodes (graceful), ~2-3m per node. can start if we want quick capacity
Lee SRE: we have traffic routing flags for 'cache_mitigation' that can redirect requests away from overloaded prefix shards to replicas. flipping that is low-risk and instant
Sam M: i'm starting a targeted rollback of PR #428 for eviction-heuristic and will flip routing flag to cache_mitigation for /v1/generate in us-west-2
Deploy-bot: rollback started: config-change-eviction-heuristic -> previous at 2026-03-15T12:13Z
Sam M: also enabling bypass for top hot prefixes to avoid eviction thrash while caches warm
Maya Infra: kicked graceful restart for kv-prefix-12 and kv-prefix-13 with drain; restarting 1 node at a time
Lee SRE: flip done for cache_mitigation routing, verifying telemetry now
Ops Jess: monitoring 5xx and timeout rates
Sam M: numbers: pre-mitigation 5xx=6.2% -> 3.0% after rollback+routing flip (2m) -> 1.1% at +6m
Tom CS: CS update: notified affected customers with workaround (retry + backoff), offered status update and assigned account manager follow-ups
Sam M: note: root cause hypothesis = overly aggressive eviction heuristic created eviction storms for a set of hot prefixes, causing cascading misses and increased upstream latency leading to gateway timeouts and 5xx
Lee SRE: leaving watches on kv read latency and miss_rate; will keep rolling restarts until miss_rate stabilizes
Maya Infra: adding temporary rule to block the eviction heuristic PR from auto-rollout until we've got canary gating for cache params
Ops Jess: also enabling additional synthetic checks that exercise top prefixes to speed warm-up post-restart
Sam M: handing off to oncall followup: @Lee SRE, @Maya Infra, @Ops Jess — please create incident doc and capture timeline, graphs, and customer impact summary. Recommend we add rollout guard for cache-related config and a short-circuit that disables the heuristic when eviction_rate spikes above threshold
Lee SRE: ack. will open SEV2 incident doc, grab traces, and include steps to reproduce in staging
Maya Infra: i'll prepare a PR to add canary gating and a safety cutoff for eviction heuristics; will schedule capacity increase for impacted shards as a preventive measure
Deploy-bot: canary rollout resumed for unrelated services
incident-bot: Incident severity: SEV2; duration to this point 00:18; responders: Sam M, Lee SRE, Maya Infra, Ops Jess, Tom CS
Sam M: we kept traffic routed through fallback replicas while caches warm. plan: keep bypass for top prefixes for ~2h and then reassess
Ops Jess: leaving monitoring watches and alert thresholds tightened for prefix eviction_rate and miss amplification
Tom CS: will send a consolidated customer update and set expectation for RCA within 48h
Sam M: closing live mitigation and handing full ownership to oncall followup for RCA/postmortem
Lee SRE: taking handoff, ack
